entry.title: Diffusion Steering via Adaptive Reward Estimation and Resampling
entry.summary: Text-to-image diffusion models can generate images that satisfy complex prompts, yet often produce images that omit requested objects, attributes, or relationships. entry.title: Physicl Scenes: An Artist-created 3D Dataset for Learning Perception and Action
entry.summary: We present Physicl Scenes, a high-quality artist-created and curated dataset of 6,499 3D scenes spanning household rooms, public interiors, and outdoor spaces. The dataset combines detailed geometry, physically based materials, and carefully composed environments with object- and part-level semantic annotations, providing rich, joint supervision for visual and embodied learning.
